data.content_ref: inline:The claim asserts a universal property of ALL rank-22 decompositions: 'any rank-22 decomposition must either fix the tensor's full automorphism group action or lie in an orbit that cannot close under the Clebsch-Gordan-style degeneracy present at rank 23.' This is a two-pronged claim, but the proposed experiment (exhaustive GF(2) search restricted to S_3-symmetric triples) tests only the first prong. The second prong ('orbit that cannot close') is left entirely untested. An empty result from the symmetry-restricted search is equally consistent with 'the obstruction hypothesis is true' and 'a rank-22 decomposition exists over Z but breaks S_3 symmetry'—the experiment's own countercondition 2 acknowledges this. Thus the experiment does not discriminate the full claim as stated; it discriminates only a sub-hypothesis. The claim's universal quantifier ('any rank-22 decomposition must...') is unsupported by an experiment that only examines symmetric candidates.
